agents.access: Installs agent definition files into your harness's agents directory; each agent then runs with whatever tools that harness grants it — review an agent's definition and scope its tool permissions before use. The agents are free; the harness and model access are not.
agents.description: A roster of ~270 specialized agent definitions across 19 divisions — engineering, design, marketing, sales, security and more — each a single Markdown file with identity, mission, workflows and deliverables, installable into Claude Code and other harnesses.
agents.name: the-agency
agents.title: The Agency
agents.why: The shelf's founding entry and the broadest proven roster: one curated collection covers the specialist-team job, so the shelf does not need dozens of single-agent entries — pick divisions, not the whole roster, and review each agent before use.
